data.title: Exotics Now Employee
data.description: A staff-facing app built for Exotics Now chauffeurs and employees — providing all the tools needed to deliver a seamless, professional luxury rental experience from pickup to drop-off.
highlights: View and accept assigned chauffeur trips
Instant access to pickup, drop-off, and renter details
Inspection photo upload at handover and return
Real-time communication with admins and owners
Clear trip timelines and status updates
